stories.title: Blast in Ratlam gun shop kills owner:Explosion occurs during welding; 3 others sustain critical injuries
stories.summary: In a shocking incident at a gun shop in Chandni Chowk, Ratlam, shop owner Yusuf Ali (58) succumbs to injuries sustained in a blast. After receiving initial treatment in Ratlam, he was referred to Indore, where he passed away late Tuesday night. Reports suggest he suffered a heart attack during treatment. The shop owner had escaped from the shop in a burnt condition, running to save his life. Explosion occurred during welding The blast reportedly took place at 4 pm on January 26 at the gun shop in Chandni Chowk. Hearing the explosion, people inside the shop rushed out to save themselves. Four individuals were badly burned and ran on the road in burning condition. People sitting in nearby shops also fled. Passersby in a Magic vehicle got down and escaped the scene. Injured in the incident are arms shop owner Yusuf Ali (58), Najim (32), Sheikh Rafiquddin (35), and customer Sandeep, son of Shankar Patidar (35). Yusuf Ali has died, while the other three are undergoing treatment in Indore. Forensic team will investigate by opening the shop The shop is scheduled to open today for a detailed investigation. After the blast, the administration had sealed the shop. On Wednesday, police along with a forensic team will remove the seal and conduct a thorough investigation. Some videos of the accident had also emerged, showing burned people running out of the shop after the explosion. First video- The footage shows people moving along the road. A young man is seen sitting on a bike outside the shop, holding a mobile. Ahead, two others are walking, one speaking on a mobile. A pickup arrives and stops near them, and the blast occurs at that moment. Second video- This video captures the shop owner and others running to save their lives. Burnt individuals were seen removing their clothes on the road due to the severity of the burns. Charred clothing and scattered shoes littered the street. Third Video- In this clip, injured customer Sandeep Patidar is seen sitting in an auto. After the blast, he first ran to a nearby paint shop and requested to make a phone call to his village to inform his family. After the accident, people made Sandeep sit in an auto. He was badly burnt, his clothes were in tatters. During this time, he asked the auto driver to make his video so he could see his face. The Ratlam gun shop blast, which occurred during welding, has claimed the life of the shop owner Yusuf Ali. Three others remain in critical condition. Forensic teams are set to examine the scene, while videos of the incident reveal the chaos and panic that followed the explosion.

stories.title: Overnight rain in Lucknow-Ayodhya, alert in 29 districts:Hailstorm in 8 cities in 24 hours, streets flood in Lucknow and Kannauj; temperatures drop
stories.summary: The weather in Uttar Pradesh has once again turned unpredictable. Rain occurred in 9 cities, including Ayodhya and Lucknow. In Lucknow and Kannauj, intermittent showers continued throughout the night, causing waterlogging on streets. Schools in Sambhal up to class 8 and in Siddharthnagar up to class 12 have been closed today due to weather conditions. An alert for hail and rain has been issued in 29 districts. Winds are expected at a speed of 20–30 km/h. According to the Meteorological Department, temperatures may drop by 3–4 degrees Celsius due to the rain. Ballia remained the coldest district in the state, recording 6.1 degrees Celsius. On Tuesday, rainfall was recorded in 15 districts. Hail was reported in 8 districts, including Moradabad, Agra, Ghaziabad, Noida, Baghpat, Hathras, Saharanpur, and Amroha. Noida experienced the heaviest hail for half an hour. In over 10 cities of western Uttar Pradesh, winds blew at a speed of 40–50 km/h. Lucknow's meteorologist Atul Singh said- Western winds are currently affecting North India. The wind cycle is active in Haryana and surrounding areas. Strong westerly jet stream is also flowing at high altitude. A new western disturbance may affect Northwest India from the night of January 30, which could lead to possible weather changes ahead. Know the conditions of major cities Now about the other cities Day temperature increased by 2 to 4 degrees Over the last 24 hours, daytime temperatures increased, especially in Meerut, Ghaziabad, Noida, and surrounding areas, with a rise of 2–4 degrees. The highest temperature was 26 degrees in Ayodhya. stories.title: Wife severs husband's tongue, family stores it as evidence:Meerut doctors fail to reattach, 26 year old victim loses ability to speak forever
stories.summary: In Uttar Pradesh’s Ghaziabad district, 26-year-old Vipin has permanently lost his ability to speak after his wife allegedly bit off his tongue with her teeth. Doctors in Meerut were unable to reattach the severed tongue. The family has brought the severed piece home and stored it in a refrigerator. They say the only reason for preserving it is to ensure that evidence can be produced if the police demand it at any stage. According to family members, Vipin’s wife Isha consumed alcohol and cigarettes, partied with her boyfriend in expensive restaurants, and drank coffee costing ₹400, while Vipin earned just ₹17–18 thousand per month. They claim the entire family was troubled by her behaviour, while Isha herself wanted to end the marriage. In an exclusive conversation with Dainik Bhaskar, the family said that on the night of the incident, Isha did not use a knife but bit off Vipin’s tongue during physical relations. Cruelty just eight months after marriage Sanjaypuri is an area in Modinagar town. Vipin, 26, a resident of the locality, works as a labourer in a welding factory. In May 2025, he married Isha, a resident of Maliyana in Meerut. On the night of January 19, 2026, a dispute broke out between the couple. During the altercation, Isha allegedly bit off Vipin’s tongue, severing it completely. Vipin’s mother, Geeta, lodged an FIR against her daughter-in-law at Modinagar police station. Police arrested Isha on January 20 and sent her to jail. Vipin was admitted to Subharti Hospital in Meerut for treatment and returned home on January 25. Abortion medicines and cigarette butts found in the room When Dainik Bhaskar reached Vipin’s home in Sanjaypuri, he was lying on a cot, wrapped in a blanket and visibly in pain. Neighbours were visiting to check on his condition. The family said they had wrapped Vipin’s severed tongue in cloth and stored it in the refrigerator. They took it out and showed it to the reporter. Due to several days having passed, the tongue had shrunk. Asked why the tongue was being preserved, Vipin’s younger brother Sunny said, “If the police or anyone else asks for evidence at any time, we will be able to provide it.” The family then showed Vipin and Isha’s room, opening a cupboard to display medicines they claimed were abortion pills, stating that Isha did not want to become a mother. They also showed cigarette butts and alleged that Isha used to smoke. Doctors said: Vipin will never be able to speak again Vipin’s brother Sunny said the family sought treatment at Subharti Hospital in Meerut. Doctors informed them that even if the tongue were reattached, it would have no life due to severed blood vessels. “Even plastic surgery will not restore his speech the way it was before,” Sunny said. Doctors stitched the remaining portion of Vipin’s tongue to allow the wound to heal. The stitches will be removed after a few days. Vipin will continue medication, but doctors have confirmed that he will not regain his ability to speak normally. Friend said: She didn’t let Vipin touch her, drank alcohol and smoked To understand how the dispute escalated, Dainik Bhaskar spoke to Vipin’s closest friend, Bobby Kumar. He said Vipin married in May 2025 and shared everything with him after marriage. “Vipin used to say his wife behaved two-faced with him. Whenever he tried to touch her, she stopped him. He would say, ‘I am human—how long can I tolerate this?’” Bobby said. He added that Vipin later began frequently buying cigarette packets from his shop. Vipin himself did not smoke and told Bobby that the cigarettes were for his wife. According to Bobby, Vipin said his wife drank alcohol, smoked cigarettes, ate chicken, partied at expensive restaurants and drank ₹400 coffee, while earning nothing herself. Vipin allegedly told him that Isha often took money from him to go out with her boyfriend. Bobby claimed that Vipin’s family had discovered months earlier that Isha was involved with another man from Meerut. She allegedly spent most of her time chatting with her boyfriend on WhatsApp and often told Vipin that her family had forcibly married her to him. “She would say she didn’t want to live with him and sometimes even called him a hijra,” Bobby alleged. Father said: Priest had refused the match, but mediator insisted Vipin’s father Ramautar said his son was married only nine months ago. Recalling how the match was finalised, he said he had asked a friend to find a bride, clearly stating that he could not afford an expensive wedding. “I wanted a simple marriage with just four people from our side,” he said. Ramautar said they were introduced to a family from Maliyana in Meerut’s TP Nagar area. While they liked the girl, she refused a simple wedding. The family took a bank loan of ₹10 lakh to meet the expenses and even constructed a separate room on the terrace for the couple. Ramautar said that horoscope matching before the wedding had raised red flags. “The priest clearly said the horoscopes did not match and refused the alliance, but the mediator insisted everything would be fine,” he said. “Now we regret not listening to the priest. After this incident, the girl’s family is threatening to file a dowry case against us. Our son’s life has been ruined, and now we are being threatened,” he added. Ramautar said problems began soon after the wedding. Isha frequently visited her parental home, did no household work, drank alcohol, smoked cigarettes, refused any relationship with Vipin and threatened him. “She used to tell my son that he was not worthy of her and that she did not like him,” he said.

stories.title: संभल में केमिस्ट एसोसिएशन ने यूजीसी कानून के खिलाफ किया विरोध प्रदर्शन
stories.summary: संभल के सीनियर केमिस्ट ड्रगिस्ट एसोसिएशन ने नए यूजीसी कानून के खिलाफ प्रदर्शन किया। इसे 'काला कानून' बताते हुए तुरंत रद्द करने की मांग की। प्रदर्शनकारियों ने काली पट्टी बांधकर बाइक रैली निकाली। एसोसिएशन ने इस कानून को बच्चों के भविष्य के लिए घातक बताया और प्रधानमंत्री को ज्ञापन सौंपा।

stories.title: हर्षोल्लास के साथ मनाया गया गणतंत्र दिवस

stories.title: भाजपा कार्यालय पर धूम धाम से मना गणतंत्र दिवस
stories.summary: संतकबीरनगर में भाजपा के जिलाध्यक्ष नीतू सिह ने गणतंत्र दिवस पर झंडारोहण किया। इस अवसर पर विधायक अंकुरराज तिवारी और अन्य पार्टी के नेता उपस्थित रहे। नीतू सिह ने गणतंत्र दिवस की महत्वता पर चर्चा करते हुए संविधान, लोकतंत्र और राष्ट्र सेवा के दायित्व को याद किया।

stories.title: मूर्ति विसर्जन के दौरान करंट की चपेट में आने से बालक की मौत

stories.title: सेनानियों के शीला पट्ट पर पुष्प अर्पित कर झुकाया शीश

stories.title: अज्ञात वाहन की ठोकर से बाइक सवार घायल

stories.title: बैंक कर्मियों की हड़ताल से एक अरब का लेन-देन प्रभावित

stories.title: झंगहा में युवक की हत्या में चार आरोपित गिरफ्तार
stories.summary: झंगहा थानाक्षेत्र के दुबौली में भूमि विवाद के चलते पंकज निषाद (38) की गोली मारकर हत्या कर दी गई। पुलिस ने चार आरोपितों को गिरफ्तार कर लिया है। मामला छह महीनों से चल रहा था। पंकज को गंभीर चोटें आईं थीं, जिससे उसकी मृत्यु हो गई। परिवार ने आरोपितों की संपत्ति कुर्क करने और आर्थिक सहायता की मांग की है।

stories.title: अस्पताल का फायर सिस्टम को फौरी तौर पर दुरुस्त किया जाए

stories.title: चोरी की घटना का खुलासा होने पर एसपी समेत पुलिस टीम को किया सम्मानित

stories.title: Avimukteshwaranand receives lowest security among all Shankaracharyas:Badrinath Jyotish Peeth head only has 'Y protection', while Puri Govardhan Peeth Shankaracharya receives 'Z+ security'
stories.summary: Badrinath Jyotish Peeth head​​​​​​​ Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati has said that the fair is fully the administration’s responsibility and they will be accountable if anything happens. He added, “We have no security arrangements. We are relying on God.” The Shankaracharya has been on a sit-in protest for 10 days. Following a commotion in his camp, he filed a complaint with the Kalpavasi Police Station, saying his life is at risk. Authorities have now installed 12 CCTV cameras at the site for security. In such a situation, the question arises: what security has Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand received? What category of security do the other 3 Shankaracharyas have? Who has the strongest security? Let's find out Question: What category of security has Avimukteshwaranand been provided with? Answer: According to Yogiraj Sarkar, the national media in-charge of Avimukteshwaranand, Shankaracharya Swami Swaroopanand Ji had Y-plus category security. This security was provided to him by the Madhya Pradesh government. Swaroopanand Ji was the Shankaracharya of Jyotishpeeth and Dwarka Peeth. He had two prominent disciples - Sadanand Saraswati and Avimukteshwaranand. After the demise of Shankaracharya Swaroopanand in September 2022, Swami Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati was given the responsibility of Jyotishpeeth and Swami Sadanand Saraswati was given the responsibility of Dwarka Peeth as successors. In such a situation, both should have received Y-plus category security, but their security was divided into two parts. They have only been given normal Y category security. In this, the Madhya Pradesh Police has provided them with two PSOs. Question: How many PSOs are deployed? Answer: A total of two government PSOs (Personal Security Officers) are deployed with Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand. One PSO is with him at all times, who carries a gun. Additionally, Avimukteshwaranand is accompanied by Parikar (staff/assistants engaged in service). The Shankaracharya carries a Danda (a symbol of religious authority/protection). However, he does not possess any weapons or other security equipment. According to the Yogiraj government, even the PSOs were pushed on January 18. Question: Has the Shankaracharya received security only during travel or events? Answer: According to the Yogiraj government, Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand has been provided 24-hour security. When Shankaracharya travels to another state, the administration there often increases security. In some districts, the escort is also increased. However, the Yogiraj government also alleged that no security is provided by the DM in Kashi, while in Lucknow, he is provided with full security. Question: Is a route chart and traffic management implemented for them? Answer: Route charts and traffic management arrangements are in place for Avimukteshwaranand. The government PSO (Personal Security Officer) remains in constant contact. Additionally, security arrangements and escort have been provided by the Mela administration in the past. However, this time it did not happen. The Yogiraj government says that considering the current situation, Maharaj Ji's security should be further increased. I have no hope from the UP government. Therefore, I demand from the Ministry of Home Affairs of the Central Government that the Shankaracharya's security be increased. The way this incident happened with him proves that there was a conspiracy to assassinate him. Therefore, it is necessary to increase Maharaj Ji's security. It is necessary to keep the Shankaracharya in a strong security cordon, so that no untoward incident or major accident occurs. Question: What about the security of the other three Shankaracharyas? Answer: The tightest security arrangement is for Shankaracharya Swami Nischalananda Saraswati of Puri Govardhan Peeth. He has been provided high-level Z-plus category security by the Odisha government. Second in line is the 70th Shankaracharya of Kanchi Kamakoti Peeth, Shri Vijayendra Saraswati. He has been given Z category security by the central government. This decision was taken after intelligence information and security-related inputs. Since then, he has been provided security cover by the Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF). Shankaracharya Swami Sadanand Saraswati of Dwarka-Sharda Peeth has also received Y-category security, similar to Avimukteshwaranand. Question: Is there a separate rule for the security of Shankaracharyas? Answer: There are no separate or special rules for the security of Shankaracharyas. They are also provided security based on the assessment of threat. The decision to determine the security category (X, Y, Y+, Z, Z+) is made after a review by the state police, intelligence agencies' reports, and the Home Department. Security is increased if the need arises and can be reduced if the threat diminishes.

stories.title: No ticket if survey report turns negative:BJP begins on-ground preparations for UP assembly elections; party feedback and RSS views also influence final decisions
stories.summary: Even though Uttar Pradesh assembly elections are 14 months away, BJP has already started preparing on the ground. The first phase of the survey to select candidates is about to begin. A company called 'Nation with Namo' has been given the responsibility to conduct the survey. It will visit every assembly constituency and report on the image of current BJP MLAs, possible alternative candidates, and key issues among the public. Senior BJP leaders say MLAs who get a negative report on their work or image in the survey are likely to lose their party tickets. Read this report Before the 2022 assembly elections, BJP had conducted electoral surveys through Jarvis and ABM. Based on the survey reports of both companies, BJP gave opportunities to new faces on 165 out of 403 seats. Tickets of more than 120 MLAs were cut. After the Lok Sabha elections, BJP has achieved big victories in Haryana, Maharashtra, Delhi, and recently in Bihar. Experts believe that BJP's next focus will now be the UP assembly elections in 2027. After 2017 and 2022, BJP wants to achieve a hat-trick with a full majority in UP in 2027 as well. Therefore, the party has slowly started its election preparations. On one hand, workers have been deployed for the Special Intensive Voter List Revision (SIR). On the other hand, the party has also started an election survey. The agency's surveyors have reached the assembly constituencies. They are also talking to district presidents, mandal presidents, workers who were expanders in 2022 and 2024, shopkeepers, small social organizations, lawyers, doctors, teachers, youth, and women. This is how the survey is conducted An agency employee said that their surveyors go to the field and stay among the public in public places. There, they start talking about election issues and then talk about the BJP's current MLA or the defeated candidate. Some questions like these are put before the public. Opinion of the organization and the Sangh as well An employee of the company said that their surveyors also contact BJP officials in the district along with RSS members. They also have detailed discussions with them about the current MLA and alternative contenders. When the report is submitted, it also mentions whether the workers and the Sangh agree with or are dissatisfied with the concerned MLA or the defeated candidate. Second round of survey will also be conducted A BJP official said that a second round of survey will also be conducted for candidate selection. It will probably be conducted by another survey agency. Both companies will conduct surveys in almost all assembly constituencies in view of the upcoming assembly elections. The official said that work has been given to two companies so that the report from the field is accurate. If the work is assigned to only one company, there is a possibility of the report being biased or one-sided. The reports from two companies make it clear which company has surveyed how deeply. This also eliminates the possibility of only one MLA or claimant's perspective coming through. More than 800 survey agents will work More than 400 survey agents from both companies will work for the assembly elections. Survey agents include political science students from Delhi University, students from IIM Lucknow, and IIT Kanpur. Conducting surveys through professionals helps in understanding the depth of issues related to the candidate, the region, social equations, internal opposition, and other matters. Until 2014, Prashant Kishor and his team were handling election management for Gujarat CM Narendra Modi. In 2014, when Prashant Kishor separated from Narendra Modi, his team member Sunil Singh formed the company A Billion Minds (ABM). Until 2024, ABM handled election management for BJP in all states, including UP, and for the Lok Sabha elections. ABM has now changed its name to ‘Nation with Namo’. This same company has also been entrusted with the responsibility of formulating management strategies, conducting surveys for candidate selection, and campaigning in the assembly elections in UP. Survey to be conducted on all seats A BJP official stated that currently, out of 403 seats in UP, the party has 258 MLAs. However, the party will conduct surveys on all 403 seats. This includes seats held by alliance partners RLD, SBSP, Apna Dal (L), and Nishad Party.

stories.title: गाड़ी से टक्कर मार हत्या के प्रयास में वांछित गिरफ्तार
stories.summary: मथुरा में थाना छाता पुलिस ने शेरगढ़ रोड पर चेकिंग के दौरान हत्या के प्रयास में वांछित आरोपी जय को गिरफ्तार किया। आरोपी ने नौ जनवरी को थार गाड़ी से बाइक सवार को टक्कर मारकर जान से मारने की धमकी दी थी। पुलिस ने आरोपी के खिलाफ कार्रवाई की है।

stories.title: यूजीसी के नियमों के खिलाफ सवर्णों ने की बैठक
stories.summary: जिगना में यूजीसी के नए नियमों के खिलाफ विरोध बढ़ रहा है। जिला पंचायत सदस्य पार्थ सिंह ने चेतावनी दी है कि यदि नियम वापस नहीं लिए गए, तो वह इस्तीफा देंगे। गौरा गांव में सवर्ण समाज की बैठक में वक्ताओं ने भेदभाव का विरोध किया और सरकार से सद्बुद्धि की कामना की।

stories.title: कार के धक्के से बाइक सवार युवक की मौत, साथी जख्मी
stories.summary: मिर्जापुर के कचरिया गांव में सोमवार को एक कार की टक्कर से बाइक सवार युवक की मौत हो गई। 20 वर्षीय आकाश कोल की मौके पर ही मौत हो गई, जबकि उसका साथी संदीप गंभीर रूप से घायल हो गया। चालक कार छोड़कर भाग गया। पुलिस ने कार को जब्त कर लिया है और मामले की जांच जारी है।

stories.title: दिल्ली से पीलीभीत जा रही कार दुर्घटनाग्रस्त, पूरनपुर के दो युवकों की मौत
stories.summary: दिल्ली से पीलीभीत लौटते समय अमरोहा में एक सड़क हादसे में बैंक मैनेजर शिवांग सक्सेना और उनके दोस्त क्षितिज अग्निहोत्री की मृत्यु हो गई। यह हादसा कार के टायर फटने के कारण हुआ। दोनों की अंत्येष्टि मंगलवार को की गई, जिससे उनके परिवारों में शोक फैल गया।

stories.title: दूध गर्म करने के दौरान फटा सिलेंडर, पूरी गृहस्थी खाक
stories.summary: गोविंदपुर टंगुनिया में एक महिला द्वारा दूध गर्म करते समय एलपीजी गैस सिलेंडर का पाइप जल गया। धमाके के बाद झोपड़ी और घरेलू सामान पूरी तरह से जल गए। इस हादसे में गृहस्वामी कमलेश शर्मा झुलस गए, जबकि एक गाय और बछिया गंभीर रूप से झुलस गईं। कुत्ते के दो बच्चे भी जलकर मर गए।

stories.title: सुबह आसमान में छाए बादलों से बढ़ी गलन
stories.summary: मिर्जापुर में मौसम में बदलाव आया है। सुबह बादल छाए रहे और गलन बढ़ गई। कृषि वैज्ञानिक प्रो. श्रीराम सिंह के अनुसार, यदि बारिश हुई तो गेहूं की फसलों का उत्पादन बेहतर होगा। ठंड से चना की फसल में कीड़े नहीं लगेंगे। आने वाले सप्ताह में मौसम इसी तरह बना रहेगा।

stories.title: फुटबाल में डायमण्ड स्पोर्टिंग क्लब और हैण्डबाल में स्टेडियम अ विजयी
stories.summary: मऊ में जिला प्रशासन और नगर पालिका परिषद के सहयोग से जूनियर फुटबाल और हैण्डबाल प्रतियोगिता का आयोजन किया गया। फुटबाल में डायमण्ड स्पोर्टिंग क्लब ने 1-0 से जीत हासिल की, जबकि हैण्डबाल में स्टेडियम अ ने 35-30 से जीत दर्ज की। प्रतियोगिता का उद्घाटन क्रीड़ाधिकारी डीपी सिंह ने किया।

stories.title: बीसलपुर में निकाली गई प्रभात फेरी
stories.summary: बीसलपुर में गणतंत्र दिवस धूमधाम से मनाया गया। स्कूल के बच्चों ने प्रभातफेरी निकाली और शहीदों के बलिदान पर सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रम प्रस्तुत किए। उपजिलाधिकारी नागेंद्र पांडे ने ध्वजारोहण किया। विभिन्न स्कूलों और संस्थानों में ध्वजारोहण समारोह आयोजित हुए, जिसमें कई प्रमुख व्यक्तियों ने भाग लिया और 36 लोकतंत्र सेनानियों को सम्मानित किया गया।

stories.title: हॉकी : सिगरा, कैंट स्टार और एलबीएस की जीत
stories.summary: वाराणसी के कोरौता मैदान पर आयोजित 7वीं लौह पुरुष सरदार वल्लभ भाई पटेल 7-ए साइड हॉकी प्रतियोगिता में दूसरे दिन चार मैच खेले गए। सिगरा स्टेडियम ने हीरो एकेडमी को 4-3 से हराया, जबकि कैंट स्टार ने रायबरेली को 4-3 से शिकस्त दी। एलबीएस ने सनराइजर्स कौशाम्बी को 7-4 से हराया। अभिनव क्लब ने यूपी कॉलेज को पेनाल्टी शूट आउट में हराकर क्वार्टर फाइनल में जगह बनाई।

stories.title: मथुरा के कारोबारी की जयपुर में हादसे में मौत, पत्नी और बहन सहित चार घायल
stories.summary: मथुरा के कारोबारी प्रदीप सांवरिया की जयपुर के समीप सड़क दुर्घटना में मौत हो गई। उनकी पत्नी और बहन समेत चार लोग घायल हुए हैं। पत्नी और बहन की हालत गंभीर है। प्रदीप अपनी बेटी की शादी के लिए भात न्योतने गए थे। परिवार में शोक का माहौल है, अंतिम संस्कार मंगलवार को किया गया।

stories.title: बीसलपुर की लौंज और बंगाली समाज की संदेश मिठाई ओडीओसी में शामिल
stories.summary: पीलीभीत में ओडीओसी (एक जनपद-एक व्यंजन) योजना के तहत बीसलपुर की लौंज और बंगाली समाज की संदेश मिठाई को चुना गया है। जिला उद्योग प्रोत्साहन एवं उद्यमिता विकास केंद्र ने इस योजना के तहत शासन को प्रस्ताव भेजा है। युवा रोजगार के लिए प्रशिक्षण प्राप्त कर रहे हैं और मुख्यमंत्री स्वरोजगार योजना से जोड़ा जा रहा है।

stories.title: परेड मैदान पर सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रमों के मध्य धूमधाम से मनाया 77 वां गणतंत्र दिवस
stories.summary: मथुरा में 77 वां गणतंत्र दिवस धूमधाम से मनाया गया। मुख्य अतिथि कैबिनेट मंत्री लक्ष्मी नारायण चौधरी ने परेड की सलामी ली और पुलिस कर्मियों को सम्मानित किया। सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रमों में छात्र-छात्राओं ने देश भक्ति की प्रस्तुति दी। अंत में विजेता छात्रों और पुलिस कर्मियों को पुरस्कार दिए गए।

stories.title: बच्चों ने प्रभात फेरी निकाल देश की एकता के नारे बुलंद किए
stories.summary: मिर्जापुर में 77वां गणतंत्र दिवस उल्लासपूर्ण माहौल में मनाया गया। स्कूली बच्चों ने प्रभात फेरी निकाली, जबकि आयुक्त और डीएम ने झंडोत्तोलन किया। सुबह सामूहिक प्रार्थना, क्रॉस कंट्री रेस, और स्काउटिंग का प्रदर्शन हुआ। अस्पतालों और जेलों में मरीजों और बंदियों को फल और भोजन वितरित किए गए। कवि सम्मेलन में देशभक्ति की रचनाएं प्रस्तुत की गईं।

stories.title: देश की अखंडता सर्वोपरि, निष्ठा-ईमानदारी से करें देशसेवा : मंत्री
stories.summary: मिर्जापुर में 77वां गणतंत्र दिवस उल्लासपूर्ण वातावरण में मनाया गया। मुख्य अतिथि आशीष पटेल ने ध्वज फहराया और परेड का निरीक्षण किया। पुलिस कर्मियों और स्कूल के बच्चों को सराहनीय कार्य के लिए पुरस्कार दिए गए। समारोह में देशभक्ति पर आधारित सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रमों ने सभी का मन मोह लिया।

stories.title: डीजीपी ने 16 पुलिसकर्मियों को सम्मानित किया
stories.summary: डीजीपी राजीव कृष्ण ने पुलिस मुख्यालय में राष्ट्रीय ध्वज फहराते हुए कहा कि पुलिसिंग का अनुभव नागरिकों के लिए सुरक्षा, सम्मान और भरोसे का प्रतीक होना चाहिए। उन्होंने 16 पुलिसकर्मियों को सम्मानित किया, जिसमें डीआईजी इमरान, आरआई आशुतोष सिंह और अन्य शामिल हैं। मड़ियांव इंस्पेक्टर शिवानंद मिश्र को विशेष सम्मान दिया गया।

stories.title: -सात जेल कर्मियों को प्रदान किए मेडल
stories.summary: मथुरा के जिला कारागार में 77 वां गणतंत्र दिवस मनाया गया। जेल अधीक्षक अंशुमन गर्ग ने राष्ट्रीय ध्वज फहराया और सभी को प्रेरित किया। इस अवसर पर 7 कार्मिकों को मेडल और बंदियों को चित्रकला प्रतियोगिता में पुरस्कार दिए गए। कई समाजसेवियों को भी प्रशस्ति पत्र प्रदान किए गए।

stories.title: पूर्व केंद्रीय मंत्री व मेरठ-हापुड़ सांसद ने शहीद रिंकल के परिवार से की मुलाकात
stories.summary: हापुड़ के भटैल निवासी जवान रिंकल बालियान जम्मू-कश्मीर में सड़क हादसे में शहीद हो गए। पूर्व केंद्रीय मंत्री संजीव बालियान और सांसद अरूण गोविल उनके घर पहुंचे और परिवार को सांत्वना दी। उन्होंने शोकाकुल परिवार को हर संभव मदद का आश्वासन दिया और कहा कि शहीद पर पूरे देश को गर्व है।

stories.title: बैंकों की हड़ताल से 200 करोड़ का लेनदेन अटका, बैंकों में लगे रहे ताले
stories.summary: मथुरा में बैंक अधिकारियों और कर्मचारियों ने यूनाइटेड फोरम ऑफ बैंक यूनियन्स के तहत एक दिवसीय हड़ताल की। हड़ताल के दौरान सभी बैंकों की 250 शाखाएं बंद रहीं, जिससे 200 करोड़ का लेनदेन प्रभावित हुआ। कर्मचारियों ने अपनी मांगों को लेकर प्रदर्शन किया और एकजुट रहने की अपील की।

stories.title: गूंजते रहे देशभक्ति के तराने, हर मन में दिखा जोश और उत्साह
stories.summary: बिलसंडा में गणतंत्र दिवस धूमधाम से मनाया गया। विधायक विवेक वर्मा, चेयरमैन डीके गुप्ता, और विभिन्न विद्यालयों के प्रबंधन ने ध्वजारोहण किया। इस अवसर पर व्यापार मंडल और समाजसेवियों ने भी भाग लिया। नगर के विभिन्न स्थानों पर स्वतंत्रता का जश्न मनाया गया।

stories.title: भाकियू ने तिरंगा ट्रैक्टर यात्रा निकाल सौंपा पत्रक
stories.summary: मिर्जापुर में गणतंत्र दिवस पर भारतीय किसान यूनियन और संयुक्त किसान मोर्चा द्वारा ट्रैक्टर तिरंगा यात्रा का आयोजन किया गया। यात्रा अहरौरा से शुरू होकर नरायनपुर में समाप्त हुई। किसानों ने धान खरीद सीमा बढ़ाने और अवैध टोल प्लाजा हटाने की मांग की। यात्रा में सैकड़ों किसान शामिल हुए।

stories.title: पूरनपुर क्षेत्र में शान से लहराया तिरंगा, हुए कार्यक्रम
stories.summary: पूरनपुर में 77वें गणतंत्र दिवस पर ध्वाजारोहण और सांस्कृतिक कार्यक्रम आयोजित किए गए। विधायक बाबूराम पासवान की अध्यक्षता में सम्मान समारोह में शहीद मनीष कुमार के परिवार को सम्मानित किया गया। रामलीला मैदान में फैंसी ड्रेस, नृत्य प्रतियोगिता का आयोजन हुआ। विभिन्न स्कूलों में भी ध्वाजारोहण किया गया।

stories.title: देश की सेवा सर्वोच्च जिम्मेदारी: जीएस विश्वविद्यालय के वरिष्ठ उपाध्यक्ष शशि शर्मा
stories.summary: पिलखुवा में जीएस विश्वविद्यालय ने 77वें गणतंत्र दिवस पर कार्यक्रम का आयोजन किया। वरिष्ठ उपाध्यक्ष शशि शर्मा और प्रो चांसलर डॉ. अंकित शर्मा ने राष्ट्रीय ध्वज फहराया। कार्यक्रम में देशभक्ति गीत, नृत्य और भजन प्रस्तुत किए गए। छात्रों और कर्मचारियों को प्रशस्ति पत्र देकर सम्मानित किया गया। कार्यक्रम का समापन मिठाई वितरण के साथ हुआ।

stories.title: गजेन्द्र कुमार त्यागी अध्यक्ष और हरीराज सिंह त्यागी प्रबन्धक बने
stories.summary: हापुड़ के रामनिवास स्मारक बालिका इण्टर कॉलेज में प्रबन्ध समिति एवं समिति प्रबन्धकारिणी के चुनाव निर्विरोध संपन्न हुए। सभी पदाधिकारी एवं सदस्य नियमानुसार निर्विरोध निर्वाचित हुए। चुनाव अधिकारी ने सभी को निर्विरोध घोषित किया। नवनियुक्त पदाधिकारियों ने विद्यालय के हित में कार्य करने का संकल्प लिया।

stories.title: A political dust storm over the Singareni coal mines
stories.summary: The Congress and the BRS are involved in mudslinging over the alleged irregularities in tenders for removal of overburden in the coal mines.

stories.title: सगी बहनों को दुष्कर्म करने की मिल रही धमकी
stories.summary: चुनार के एक गांव में एक व्यक्ति ने सीएम पोर्टल पर दो लोगों के खिलाफ गंभीर आरोप लगाए हैं। पीड़ित की दो बेटियाँ हैं, जिन्हें आरोपी लगातार दुष्कर्म की धमकी दे रहे हैं। पुलिस ने आरोपियों को पूछताछ के लिए बुलाया, लेकिन कोई ठोस कार्रवाई नहीं की गई। पीड़ित ने न्याय के लिए एसएसपी से भी संपर्क किया है।

stories.title: सऊदी से नौ माह बाद शव पहुंचा गांव, परिजनों में कोहराम
stories.summary: इंदारा में सऊदी अरब में काम करने गए युवक चंदन राजभर की मृत्यु के नौ माह बाद शव घर पहुंचा। 26 वर्षीय चंदन 3 मई 2025 को सऊदी अरब गया था। शव आते ही परिवार में मातम छा गया। चंदन की पत्नी, मां और बच्चे रो रहे हैं। स्थानीय नेता ने परिवार को आर्थिक मदद का आश्वासन दिया।

stories.title: एलडीए की झांकी प्रथम, सचिवालय की दूसरे स्थान पर
stories.summary: गणतंत्र दिवस परेड में एलडीए की झांकी ने प्रथम स्थान प्राप्त किया। इसमें लखनऊ के बदलते स्वरूप को दर्शाया गया, जिसमें पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री की प्रतिमाएं और 'राष्ट्र प्रेरणा स्थल' का मॉडल शामिल था। जन भवन सचिवालय की झांकी ने द्वितीय और सूचना विभाग की झांकी ने तृतीय स्थान प्राप्त किया।

stories.title: छिटपुट ओलावृष्टि के साथ बारिश से मौसम हुआ सर्द
stories.summary: मथुरा में बसंत पंचमी के बाद सर्दी से राहत की उम्मीद थी, लेकिन मंगलवार को बारिश और ओलावृष्टि के साथ मौसम ने करवट ली। आईएमडी ने घने कोहरे और आगे बारिश की संभावना जताई है। इससे किसानों और लोगों की मुश्किलें बढ़ गई हैं, खासकर उन किसानों के लिए जिन्होंने फसल में पानी दिया था।

stories.title: प्रस्तावित हेरिटेज सिटी के विकास के मास्टर प्लान 2031 को लेकर मंथन
stories.summary: -उप्र ब्रज तीर्थ विकास परिषद सभागार में हुई बैठक में मास्टर प्लान की समीक्षाप्रस्तावित हेरिटेज सिटी के विकास के मास्टर प्लान 2031 को लेकर मंथनप्रस्ताव

stories.title: 'We all know someone who was killed' - Iran protesters tell BBC of brutal crackdown
stories.summary: Young Iranians able tell the BBC how they saw friends and other people die as security forces crushed protests earlier this month.

stories.title: एसडीएम ने ब्लाक का किया निरीक्षण, किया निर्देशित
stories.summary: उप जिलाधिकारी राजेश कुमार अग्रवाल ने फतेहपुर मंडाव विकासखंड कार्यालय का औचक निरीक्षण किया। उन्होंने एग्री स्टैक कार्य की समीक्षा करने और उन ग्राम पंचायतों में कार्य प्रारंभ करने का निर्देश दिया जहां अभी तक कार्य नहीं हुआ है। संबंधित अधिकारियों को चेतावनी दी गई कि समय पर कार्य न होने पर कार्रवाई की जाएगी।

stories.title: लाखों के बकाए पर कटवाए गए एक हजार से अधिक विद्युत कनेक्शन
stories.summary: -लाइट जुड़वाने को विद्युत कार्यालयों पर लगी रही लोगों की भीड़लाखों के बकाए पर कटवाए गए एक हजार से अधिक विद्युत कनेक्शन

stories.title: 850 करोड़ रुपये की नई आवासीय एवं विकास योजनाओं का प्रस्ताव पास
stories.summary: मथुरा-वृंदावन विकास प्राधिकरण की बोर्ड बैठक 850 करोड़ रुपये की नई आवासीय एवं विकास योजनाओं का प्रस्ताव पास850 करोड़ रुपये की नई आवासीय एवं विकास योज

stories.title: संप्रेषण का प्रभावी तरीका है भारतीय ज्ञान परम्परा
stories.summary: काशी विद्यापीठ में ‘भारतीय ज्ञान परंपरा का संप्रेषण: सामाजिक, सांस्कृतिक और साहित्यिक परिप्रेक्ष्य’ विषय पर संगोष्ठी की शुरुआत हुई। इसमें प्रमुख अतिथि प्रो. देवी प्रसाद द्विवेदी ने भारतीय परंपरा के महत्व को बताया। संगोष्ठी में विभिन्न विद्वानों ने अपने विचार साझा किए और ‘नमन’ शोध पत्रिका का लोकार्पण भी किया गया।

stories.title: एम्स के समकक्ष बने सर सुंदरलाल अस्पताल : कुलपति
stories.summary: बीएचयू के कुलपति प्रो. अजित कुमार चतुर्वेदी ने सर सुंदरलाल अस्पताल के किचन, लॉन्ड्री और डॉक्टर लाउंज के नवीनीकरण कार्य का उद्घाटन किया। उन्होंने कहा कि संस्थान को एम्स के समकक्ष लाने का प्रयास किया जाएगा और अस्पताल में चिकित्सा शोध को बढ़ावा देने के लिए सूचना प्रबंधन प्रणाली शुरू की जाएगी।

stories.title: पुलिस मुठभेड़ में 50 हजार के इनामिया दो बदमाश गिरफ्तार
stories.summary: कोपागंज क्षेत्र में रविवार रात चेकिंग के दौरान पुलिस और बदमाशों के बीच मुठभेड़ हुई। पुलिस पर फायरिंग करने वाले दो बदमाशों को गोली लगी और उन्हें गिरफ्तार कर लिया गया। दोनों बदमाश लूट के आभूषण और तमंचे के साथ पकड़े गए। इन पर 50-50 हजार रुपये का इनाम था।

stories.title: बांके बिहारी कॉरीडोर के लिए एक और रजिस्ट्री
stories.summary: मथुरा में श्री बांके बिहारी जी मंदिर के आस-पास जनसुविधाओं के विकास के लिए दूसरी रजिस्ट्री हुई है। स्थानीय निवासी मनीष मिश्रा ने 322.32 वर्ग मीटर भूमि का बैनामा ठाकुर जी के नाम किया। इस परियोजना से श्रद्धालुओं को बेहतर सुविधाएं मिलेंगी और धार्मिक पर्यटन को बढ़ावा मिलेगा।

stories.title: जिम संचालक इमरान की कस्टडी रिमांड पर अभी फैसला नहीं
stories.summary: मिर्जापुर में जिम संचालक इमरान को यौन शोषण और धर्मांतरण मामले में गिरफ्तार किया गया है। उसे दिल्ली एयरपोर्ट से पकड़ा गया था। पुलिस ने उसकी कस्टडी रिमांड के लिए कोर्ट में अपील की, लेकिन रिमांड नहीं मिली। मामले में अब तक सात आरोपी पकड़े जा चुके हैं, जबकि एक फरार है।

stories.title: सभी पीएचसी-सीएचसी पर मौजूद रहें चिकित्सक: डीएम
stories.summary: मिर्जापुर के डीएम पवन कुमार गंगवार ने सभी पीएचसी-सीएचसी पर चिकित्सकों की शत प्रतिशत उपस्थिति का निर्देश दिया। लापरवाही पर कठोर कार्रवाई की चेतावनी दी। उन्होंने स्वास्थ्य केंद्रों पर दवाओं की उपलब्धता, एचआईवी जांच, और जननी सुरक्षा योजना के तहत लाभार्थियों को समय से भुगतान करने के लिए भी निर्देश दिए।

stories.title: एसएसवी कॉलेज में सड़क सुरक्षा जागरूकता कार्यक्रम हुआ
stories.summary: हापुड़ के एसएसवी पीजी कॉलेज में सड़क सुरक्षा जागरूकता कार्यक्रम का आयोजन किया गया। इसमें विभिन्न कॉलेजों के छात्रों ने प्रतियोगिताओं में भाग लिया। उपसंभागीय परिवहन अधिकारी रमेश चौबे ने सड़क दुर्घटनाओं के कारणों के बारे में जानकारी दी। नुक्कड़ नाटक में एकेपी कॉलेज ने पहला स्थान प्राप्त किया।

stories.title: एसआईआर में साक्ष्य दिखाने पहुंचे मतदाता
stories.summary: हापुड़ में 6 जनवरी को विशेष प्रगाढ़ पुनरीक्षण (एसआईआर) की अनंतिम सूची प्रकाशित की गई, जिसमें 2,57,903 निर्वाचक मतदाता सूची से बाहर किए गए। अब कुल 11,56,699 में से 8,98,796 मतदाता बचे हैं। 1,26,972 मतदाताओं को 2003 में कोई मैपिंग नहीं मिली थी, जिन्हें नोटिस भेजे गए हैं। दावे और आपत्ति 6 फरवरी तक ली जाएंगी।

stories.title: बैंकों की हड़ताल से 50 करोड़ का लेनदेन प्रभावित
stories.summary: हापुड़ में बैंकों के कर्मचारियों की 5 दिन काम करने की मांग को लेकर हड़ताल के कारण 50 करोड़ का लेनदेन प्रभावित हुआ। ग्राहक बिना लेनदेन के लौटे और एटीएम में भी नकदी खत्म होने से परेशानी का सामना करना पड़ा। सरकारी बैंकों में कामकाज ठप रहा, जबकि प्राईवेट बैंकों में सेवाएं सामान्य रहीं।

stories.title: 104 साल पुराने मंदिर में 2500 साल पुरानी औलोकिक प्रतिमा
stories.summary: हापुड़ में गढ़ रोड स्थित सुमतिनाथ मंदिर का शताब्दी वर्ष धूमधाम से मनाया जा रहा है। 2500 साल पुरानी प्रतिमा मंदिर में विराजमान है। आज मंदिर के शिखर पर ध्वजारोहण किया जाएगा। मंदिर का निर्माण 104 साल पहले हुआ था और इसकी दीवारों पर सोने की परतें लगी हैं।

stories.title: आज की युवा पीढ़ी अपनी सांस्कृतिक पहचान भूल रही: अश्वनी उपाध्याय

stories.title: Poet Munawwar Rana’s daughter alleges dowry torture:Says, 'Husband issued triple talaq abandoned family'
stories.summary: Famous poet Munawwar Rana’s daughter has filed a case alleging triple talaq and dowry harassment. The complainant, Hiba Rana, has accused her husband and in-laws of demanding dowry, subjecting her to physical abuse, and later issuing triple talaq. An FIR has been registered at Saadatganj police station in Lucknow. According to the complaint, Hiba Rana was married to Syed Mohammad Sakib, a resident of Sakirye House in Karimganj, on December 19, 2013. She alleged that soon after the nikah, her in-laws began demanding dowry. When the demands were not fulfilled, she was allegedly assaulted and forced out of the house. Not allowed to take children: Hiba Rana Hiba further claimed that she was not allowed to take both of her children with her while being expelled from the matrimonial home. However, when Dainik Bhaskar contacted Munawwar Rana’s other daughter, Sumaiya Rana, regarding the allegations, she declined to confirm the claims. She stated that there was “nothing of this sort” and did not elaborate further. ‘They demanded ₹20 Lakh and flat’ Hiba Rana alleged that at the time of her wedding, her family gave gold and diamond jewellery along with ₹10 lakh in cash as dowry. However, soon after she reached her matrimonial home, her husband Syed Mohammad Sakib and father-in-law allegedly began demanding additional dowry. According to Hiba, the fresh demands included ₹20 lakh in cash and a flat. She claimed that her family fulfilled these demands on several occasions in an attempt to save her marriage, but despite this, the harassment and pressure for dowry continued unabated. Thrown out after triple talaq Hiba stated that on April 9, 2025, her husband allegedly abused and brutally assaulted her. When her sister, Arshia Rana (Tina), arrived at the house to meet her, the situation worsened. Hiba alleged that her husband became more aggressive and pronounced triple talaq. She further claimed that after divorcing her verbally, her husband pushed her out of the house and locked her children—son Syed Fawaz and daughter Hayyam Fatima—inside a room. Police officials said that the case has been registered based on the complaint and that the matter is currently under investigation. Further action will be taken after the probe is completed.

stories.title: 100 women attack liquor stores in Lalitpur:Protesters break locks, dump liquor worth ₹15 lakh on road
stories.summary: Over 100 women, troubled by harassment, vandalized two liquor shops in Lalitpur. The women first blocked the road in protest. Then they broke the locks, entered the shops and caused extensive damage. Liquor worth lakhs were thrown on the street. After this, the women split into 2 groups. One group threw liquor packets on the road, while the other group broke bottles with sticks. Liquor flowed like water on the road. The chaos continued for about an hour. Upon receiving information, some police personnel reached there but could not gather courage to stop the women. During the commotion, traffic was jammed on the road. When the women had emptied both liquor shops, they returned to their villages. During this time, a 2-kilometer-long traffic jam persisted for about an hour. Police force from 5 stations arrived at the scene. However, by then the situation had normalized. The liquor bottles scattered on the road were removed and the traffic jam was cleared. The incident took place on Tuesday afternoon in Khitwans village on the Mahrauni-Lalitpur road. Now read the full matter A composite liquor shop opened near the population in Khitwans village in April 2025. There is also a country liquor shop nearby. Both shops have the same owner. Women allege that since the liquor shop opened here, it has become difficult to walk on the road. Drunk people make comments on women and girls. Young children in the village are also getting spoiled. Drunkards often create chaos on the road in an intoxicated state. They had been protesting against this for a long time. Hundreds of women arrived with sticks in the afternoon Around 12:30 PM on Tuesday, about 110 women started protesting in front of the shop demanding closure of the liquor store. Seeing the commotion, Hitendra Kumar, the salesman of the composite shop, pulled down the shutter, locked it and fled from the spot. He informed the police. Broke the shutter lock and entered Meanwhile, women reached both shops and broke the locks to enter inside. They started throwing boxes of country liquor, foreign liquor and beer cans onto the road. Some women began breaking them. Two policemen arrived at the scene after receiving information about the commotion and vandalism. However, seeing the agitated women, they could not gather courage to stop them. The women continued vandalizing in front of both policemen. During this time, traffic got jammed on the Mahrauni-Lalitpur route. Women said - If the shop opens again, we will break it again Women demanded that these shops should be removed from the village. If shops are set up again, there will be vandalism again. After both shops were emptied, the women returned. Meanwhile, upon receiving information about the road blockade, forces from 5 police stations reached the spot. Police got the liquor and bottles spread on the road cleaned with brooms. After that, the traffic jam could be cleared. Woman said - Drunkards had killed her husband Holding a stick in her hand, Guddi Devi said - On Diwali day, drunkards here got into a fight and killed my husband. When we complained, the police were also bought off. No action was taken. The shopkeeper said that you can't do anything to us, complain wherever you want. We are poor people, couldn't do anything. That's why today we have picked up sticks. Salesman said - Expensive liquor bottles were also broken Beer and English liquor shop salesman Hitendra Kumar said - Seeing the women's protest, I pulled down the shop's shutter. But the women broke the lock and brought all the liquor from inside onto the road. Expensive liquor bottles were also broken. The shop had liquor worth up to 2000 rupees. Now nothing is left. The women have caused damage of about 15 lakh rupees. The CCTV camera has also been broken. CO Mahrauni Rakshpal Singh said- In Khitwans, some women broke bottles and packets at the government contract domestic and English liquor shop. Force from 5 police stations reached the spot and pacified the matter. An FIR is being registered based on the shop owner's complaint.

stories.title: Stone-pelting at officials in Ballia creates chaos:Bulldozer windshield smashed; police use tear gas to control mob
stories.summary: On Tuesday in Ballia, a team that had gone to remove illegal encroachments was chased and attacked by locals. Stones were pelted at the bulldozer and the revenue team, forcing the driver to flee the spot with the machine. Initially, the police tried to control the situation, but as the unrest escalated, one company of PAC—around 150 personnel—was deployed. To disperse the crowd, the PAC fired tear gas shells. The chaos continued for nearly one and a half hours. After the situation was brought under control, administrative officials carried out the demolition of two illegally constructed houses using a bulldozer. Tension prevailed throughout the operation. The entire incident took place in Hathoj village under the Khejuri police station area of Ballia district. See pictures of commotion Understand complete matter... Actually, Siddharth Ranjan Rai, son of Sunil Kumar Rai from Hathoj village, had filed a petition in the High Court in February 2024 regarding encroachment on government land in the village. The court, after hearing the case in December 2024, ordered the removal of the encroachment. Officials say there are more than 2000 in the village. The houses of Ram Govind and Ram Bachan in the village were coming under encroachment. Both people were given notice to remove encroachment 15 days ago. On Tuesday afternoon, Tehsildar Devendra Nath Pandey, Naib Tehsildar CP Yadav, Kanungo Rajesh Singh, and Lekhpal Amit Rai from Sikandarpur Tehsil arrived to remove the encroachment. They were accompanied by police force from five stations. A bulldozer team also went with them. As soon as the work of demolishing both marked houses with bulldozer began, the villagers became agitated. More than 50 people started protesting against the bulldozer. Within moments, the crowd became angry and attacked the bulldozer, breaking its glass. Police Took Control Given the seriousness of the situation, forces from five pre-deployed police stations took charge. Police had to fire several rounds of tear gas to control the crowd. Despite this, the protests continued and PAC had to be called in when the situation deteriorated. The crowd began stone-pelting at the police force. Police responded with mild force to disperse the crowd and brought the situation under control. After intense efforts, the administration completed the anti-encroachment drive. The commotion continued for about one and a half hours. Villagers alleged that police entered houses and damaged motorcycles, electrical equipment, and house windows. They also claimed that everyone, including women, was chased and beaten. ASP Dinesh Kumar Shukla stated- During the commotion, people were calmed down and the operation was completed. A case is being registered against some people based on the complaint filed by Lekhpal Amit Rai for allegedly stone pelting on the team. stories.title: UP Police constable recruitment:Exam dates announced for 32,679 posts; written test to be held over 3 days in June
stories.summary: The dates for the UP Police Constable Recruitment–2025 examination for 32,679 posts have been officially announced. The Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB) confirmed that the written examination will be conducted in June 2026. The official notification was issued on Tuesday evening. As per the notice, the written exam will be held on June 8, June 9, and June 10, with the test conducted in two shifts each day across the state. The Recruitment Board has advised candidates to regularly check the official website – uppbpb.gov.in – for updates related to admit cards, examination centres, and other important instructions. The board clarified that all official information will be released only through the official portal and candidates should avoid relying on rumours or unofficial sources. Application process continued till January 30 The Recruitment Board had issued notification for 32,679 Constable and equivalent posts on December 31, 2025. The application process started from December 31, 2025 and continued till January 30, 2026. The written exam will be of 300 marks. 150 questions will be asked in 2 hours. Each question will be worth 2 marks. The negative marking system has been eliminated. Minimum passing marks have also been set. Syllabus Only candidates who pass the written exam will be eligible to participate in the physical test. The written exam scores will also be added to the final merit. However, UPPRPB has set minimum passing marks for clearing the written exam to participate in the physical test. General: 30 percent (90 marks out of 300) EWS: 25 percent (75 marks out of 300) OBC: 25 percent (75 marks out of 300) SC/ST: 20 percent (60 marks out of 300) Learn about recruitment On the evening of December 31, the Yogi government issued a notification for direct recruitment to 32,679 posts. These included positions in Civil Police as well as PAC, Special Security Force (SSF), Women's Battalion, Mounted Police and Jail Warders. In Civil Police, recruitment will be done for 10,469 posts for both female and male candidates. While in PAC, there are 15,131 posts vacant for men. In UP SSF, there are 1341 vacancies for male candidates.

stories.title: 'Ikra Hasan should marry a Gurjar to avoid Halala':'She would also be saved from Triple Talaq' - Shamli Hindu saint's jibe at Kairana MP
stories.summary: SP MP Iqra Hasan from Kairana in Uttar Pradesh has once again been drawn into controversy following remarks made at a public event in Shamli. At a Hindu conference held on January 31, Swami Ram Vishal Das of Gauri Shankar Gaushala said that Iqra Hasan should marry a Gurjar, claiming it would protect her from practices such as triple talaq and halala. A video of the remarks surfaced on Tuesday and has since triggered criticism. Swami Ram Vishal Das made the statement while addressing the gathering, referring directly to the Kairana MP. This is not the first time Iqra Hasan has faced such comments. About six months ago in Moradabad, Karni Sena’s national vice president Yogendra Rana had made objectionable remarks about her. In a video shared on social media, Rana claimed he was ready to marry Iqra Hasan and said she could continue practising Islam and offering namaz at his home. Iqra Hasan is a Samajwadi Party Member of Parliament representing Kairana. No official response from her side was available at the time of writing. Actually, there was a Hindu conference in Maharaj Kandela village on January 31. Swami Ram Vishal Das of Gauri Shankar Gaushala also attended it. He said from the stage- When Iqra Hasan came to ask for votes among the Gurjar community, she had said that I am your daughter, I am also a Gurjari, I am also from your caste, please vote for me. On this, Swami Ram Vishal Das gave a suggestion to Iqra Hasan. Said, Iqra Hasan should marry a Gurjar youth. Doing so would make it easier to avoid situations like triple talaq and halala with father-in-law. Swami Ram Vishal Das said to the Gurjar community in his speech that during voting, the community's support should not be limited to just votes, but it can also be converted into relationships. After the video surfaced, a debate started on social media. Many people are condemning Swami Ram Vishal Das's statement, while some are describing it as a general comment at a religious conference. Local people and political parties have also reacted to the statement.

stories.title: ‘Will Shankaracharya’s monastery face bulldozer action?’ ask Gurukul Children:Avimukteshwaranand says, 'Attempts are being made to intimidate Hindus'
stories.summary: Following the controversy at the Prayagraj Magh Mela, Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati has continued to criticise the state government. On Tuesday, he referred to a question raised by children studying in Gurukuls. The Shankaracharya said that children were asking where they would study if their monastery was demolished. He alleged that the government and the administrative machinery were deliberately creating such circumstances that were instilling fear in Hindu society, particularly among children studying in Gurukuls. He claimed that bulldozer action could be taken against those who speak out against the government, calling it a planned atmosphere of fear. Before leaving for his tour on Tuesday morning, Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati said at his ashram in Varanasi that even during the Mughal period, Hindus made sacrifices to protect their religious symbols but never had their sikha (hair tuft) cut. “Today, the same sikha is being forcibly pulled by the police. This is an attempt to mentally intimidate Hindu society,” he alleged. He also appealed to Hindu society not to vote for those who harm the cow, which he described as sacred. Hindu children should study religion in Gurukul, not government Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand alleged that the purpose of such actions is to prevent Hindu children from going to Gurukuls to study Sanatan Dharma and becoming religious preachers in the future. He called it a conspiracy to weaken the Hindu system. Shankaracharya says - Ban cow meat exports Shankaracharya said - On one hand the Chief Minister calls himself a saint and devotee, while on the other hand according to government figures, large quantities of meat are being exported from Uttar Pradesh. He claims that cow meat trade is being conducted in the name of buffalo meat, and laboratory tests of seized containers confirm the presence of cow meat. They questioned whether such a person deserves to be called a saffron-clad saint and ascetic. They appealed to Hindu society not to vote for those who harm mother cow. They clarified that "will fix by beating" does not mean violence, but rather not voting through democratic means. Shankaracharya said - Given 40 days' time Shankaracharya said - Now the era of lies is about to end, and followers of Sanatan Dharma will have to stand with truth. I have given 40 days' time and appealed that those who wear saffron clothes and are involved in meat trade should either quit this business or stop this hypocrisy. He said - As a Shankaracharya, it is his responsibility to present the truth to Sanatan Dharma followers, and he is fully prepared to fulfill this responsibility. MP Sanjay Singh said - What happened with Shankaracharya at Magh Mela was wrong AAP MP Sanjay Singh raised the issue in Parliament during Monday’s session, referring to the controversy surrounding the Magh Mela. He said that a disturbing incident took place when Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati was about to take a ritual bath. Sanjay Singh alleged that the Shankaracharya’s disciples and students were dragged by their hair and beaten. He said the Shankaracharya had demanded that he would take the bath only if the government and administration admitted their mistake. However, he eventually left without performing the ritual. Questioning the administration, Sanjay Singh said, “How big a religious contractor are you that you send letters through the tehsil asking whether someone is a Shankaracharya or not?” He further said that in today’s India, even the Aravalli range has to be told whether it is a mountain, Delhi’s air has to be told whether it is polluted, and voters have to be told whether they are citizens of the country. ‘Those who failed to show degrees now seek proof from Shankaracharya’ Sanjay Singh said that people who could not produce their educational degrees even after 12 years are now demanding proof from Shankaracharya to establish his religious position. Commenting on claims of India’s growing global influence, he said the country had recently seen Indians being deported from the United States in handcuffs. He also referred to former US President Donald Trump’s repeated claims that he stopped an India-Pakistan conflict by threatening tariffs and trade deals.

stories.title: Man killed over affair dispute in Moradabad:Wife tells boyfriend to kill husband to ‘continue relationship’; 4 accused arrested
stories.summary: A woman in Moradabad allegedly plotted the murder of her husband with the help of her lover after he objected to their relationship. Police said the woman told her boyfriend that if he wanted to continue the relationship, he would have to kill her husband. Acting on this, the boyfriend, along with two accomplices, allegedly drowned the woman’s husband in a canal. Police arrested the woman, her lover, and two other accused on Tuesday. During interrogation, the woman told police that her husband did not allow her to meet her lover and frequently assaulted her. “I was under severe stress, which is why I got my lover to kill my husband,” she allegedly confessed. The incident took place in Sirsawan village Godhi under the Bhojpur police station area. The victim’s body was recovered from a canal on January 30, police said. Akhtar Ali (43), a resident of Godhi village in Bhojpur police station area, was married to Shabina (36) 19 years ago. Akhtar ran a tea shop in the village. They have one daughter Zehra (18) and 5 sons Ayaan (17), Faizan (15), Salman (12), Shifan (10) and Faiz (7). Akhtar Ali's brother Afsar Ali said - Shabina was having an affair with Altaf (35), who lives in the same village. Akhtar Ali and Shabina often had fights over this matter. Akhtar Ali was missing from home since January 27 Afsar Ali said - Akhtar had left home on January 27 to buy groceries. But he did not return. Searched a lot but could not find any trace of him. A missing person report was filed on the morning of January 28. Two days later, on January 30, passersby saw his body in a canal in Sirsawa Ghosiyan forest. After this, the police informed us. When the post-mortem of the body was done, it was found that Akhtar Ali died due to drowning. The police were preparing to close the case considering it an accident. Then SSP Satpal Antil was informed about Shabina and Altaf's affair. Confessed to murder during interrogation After receiving the information, the Senior Superintendent of Police directed a special team to probe the case from this angle. Police detained Shabina and her alleged lover Altaf and began questioning them. During interrogation, both allegedly confessed to their involvement in the murder. Following this, police also arrested two other accused, Santa alias Santa and Ranjit Singh. Investigators have recovered the car used in the crime and the clothes of the victim, Akhtar Ali, from the possession of the accused. Husband allegedly assaulted her for meeting lover According to police, Shabina stated that her husband Akhtar Ali would not allow her to meet Altaf and would assault her whenever he found out about the relationship. She told investigators that she no longer wanted to live with her husband and wished to be with her lover. She allegedly said that repeated beatings pushed her into planning the murder with Altaf. Shabina claimed she told Altaf that she could no longer tolerate the violence and asked him to eliminate her husband if he wanted to continue the relationship. Police said Altaf, along with his two village associates Santa and Ranjit Singh, took Akhtar Ali in a car to a canal, where he was allegedly killed by drowning and his body dumped in the same canal. The accused later hid the victim’s clothes, which have now been recovered during the investigation.

stories.title: Inspector arrested taking ₹50 thousand bribe in Ghaziabad:Takes money inside police station; vigilance team catches him with cash bundle
stories.summary: The vigilance team arrested an inspector with a 50 thousand rupee bribe in Ghaziabad. The inspector had demanded money from a former pradhan by threatening to send him to jail. He provided this information to the vigilance team. The team laid a trap to catch the inspector. The inspector was sitting in the office. At that time, the former pradhan gave him 50 thousand rupees as a bribe. As soon as the inspector put the money in his pocket, the team caught him red-handed. The vigilance team took Inspector Jaipal Singh Rawat of Niwari police station with them. He is a 2013 batch daroga. He became an inspector just a year ago after getting promoted. Before this, he was posted in surveillance in Hapur. FIR was filed against former pradhan on January 2 Rakesh Kumar alias Bittu, a resident of Abupur village under the Niwari police station area in Ghaziabad, served as village pradhan from 2000 to 2005. His wife is a government schoolteacher posted in Hafizpur, Hapur. The former pradhan alleged that on January 2, 2026, a case was registered against him based on a complaint by Vijay Singh, accusing him of making derogatory remarks against the Chief Minister and the Prime Minister. He claimed the allegations were false and politically motivated due to electoral rivalry in the village. According to Rakesh Kumar, the alleged incident was shown at 4 pm on January 2, when he was present at an SBI bank branch. “My location and CCTV footage can be verified. I did not post anything in any group,” he said, calling the FIR part of a conspiracy. He further alleged that Inspector Jaipal Rawat threatened him with jail and demanded ₹50,000, saying that since an FIR had already been lodged, “something would have to be written.” Rakesh Kumar said he approached senior officers, including the ACP Modinagar and DCP Rural Surendra Nath Tiwari, while his wife Babita Rani also submitted a complaint. Despite assurances of an inquiry, he claimed no action was taken. He alleged that the inspector later raided his house and repeatedly harassed and abused him under the threat of arrest. “I kept running from office to office for nearly a month, but no one listened,” he said. Finally, he approached the Meerut Vigilance Department. Officials there reportedly laid a trap and asked him to proceed with the bribe payment. On February 1, he allegedly handed over ₹50,000 to the inspector in his office, after which the vigilance team arrived and caught the inspector red-handed. The affected former pradhan said that on December 10, he had organised a programme for district in-charge minister Asim Arun. A library inauguration was also held on the same day, and CCTV cameras are installed all around his house. He alleged that despite this, he was accused of removing a board. “At the time the incident is shown, my location was at the bank,” he said, adding that the allegations were false. The former pradhan further claimed that the inspector repeatedly threatened him, saying the investigating officer would not remove his name from the case without his approval. “If money is not paid, I can send you to jail even for a day on charges of disturbing peace, but I will definitely send you to jail,” the inspector allegedly told him.

stories.title: Uttarakhand opens 83 Himalayan peaks for mountaineers nationwide:Govt waives all fees and launches single window system to boost affordable adventure tourism
stories.summary: In a major push to boost adventure tourism, the Uttarakhand government has, for the first time, opened 83 major mountain peaks across the Garhwal and Kumaon Himalayas to all mountaineers. Along with this decision, the state has completely waived government fees for Indian mountaineers, making mountaineering significantly more accessible and affordable. The move has generated widespread interest, with many aspiring climbers seeking clarity on which peaks are most suitable, how difficult they are, and how to plan an expedition. How will mountaineers benefit ? Until now, mountaineering was often considered an expensive pursuit, largely limited to sponsored or elite expeditions due to high government charges. Under the new Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), peak fees, camping charges, trail management fees and environmental fees have all been reduced to zero for Indian mountaineers. This translates into an average saving of ₹15,000–₹20,000 per expedition, significantly lowering overall costs. Foreign mountaineers have also received relief. The separate expedition fee earlier charged by the Forest Department has been abolished. They will now only need to pay the fees set by the Indian Mountaineering Foundation (IMF), New Delhi, making the approval process faster and less complicated. Which peaks have been opened? A total of 83 peaks, ranging in height from 5,700 metres to 7,756 metres, have been opened under the new policy. These include some of India’s most iconic mountains such as Kamet, Nanda Devi (East), Chaukhamba, Trishul, Satopanth, Shivling and Panchachuli. The peaks are spread across Chamoli, Uttarkashi, Pithoragarh, Bageshwar and Rudraprayag districts. The government aims to encourage organised and regulated mountaineering in border and remote areas while maintaining a balance between safety and environmental protection. Registration through Single Window System To simplify permissions, the government has introduced the Uttarakhand Mountaineering Permission System (UKMPS). Mountaineers can now apply online through the portal mountaineering.uk.gov.in, eliminating the need for physical paperwork and multiple office visits. Applicants must upload route details, team composition, insurance documents and guide information. This single-window system is designed to ensure transparency and quicker approvals. Choosing the right peak For beginners with trekking experience, peaks around 6,000 metres such as Rudragaira, Jogin Group and Kalanag are considered suitable starting points. Mountaineers with prior high-altitude experience can attempt 7,000-metre peaks like Kamet, Satopanth, Trishul and Chaukhamba. For those seeking technical and demanding climbs, peaks such as Shivling, Thalay Sagar, Changabang and Meru offer some of the toughest challenges in the Indian Himalayas. Best season for climbing Choosing the right season is crucial, as Himalayan weather can change rapidly. May to June is regarded as the safest period, with relatively stable snow conditions and clearer weather. Climbing is also possible from September to October, though temperatures are lower. Expeditions are not advised during July and August due to heavy rainfall and landslide risks. Winter expeditions from November to March are suitable only for highly experienced mountaineers. This policy marks a significant shift in making high-altitude mountaineering more inclusive while promoting Uttarakhand as a global adventure destination.

Pawan Singh makes surprise marriage proposal during live show:Says, ‘I may not be fair or handsome, but I am cultured dependable’
stories.summary: Bhojpuri film industry’s power star Pawan Singh made a surprising marriage proposal to an actress during a live show. The moment occurred during an on-stage question-and-answer session between the two, which has now gone viral on social media. A 3 minute 26 second video clip shows Pawan Singh standing on stage with the actress when he asks her, “Are you married?” She replies, “No, not yet. I’m looking for a boy — someone who is handsome, well-mannered, reliable, a fighter, cultured, and earning well. If you find someone like that, let me know.” Hearing this, Pawan Singh immediately turned the moment into a light-hearted yet bold proposal. He said, “Why look elsewhere when someone is standing right in front of you? You can see everything clearly. Choose from what’s here. Tell me what is missing.” He then spoke openly about himself, saying, “I am dusky, I am dark, and I am hardworking. I may not be handsome, but I have values. I am reliable. In today’s age of fashion, there is no guarantee — only warranty. But I can confidently say that this man is reliable. If the other person doesn’t feel right, that’s a different matter. But I am reliable. I was reliable, I am reliable, and I will remain reliable.” The audience responded with loud cheers and applause as the actress smiled at his unexpected proposal, making the moment one of the most talked-about highlights of the live show. See photos Pawan Singh says - Now time has reversed The actress said, 'You know today's boys. In the morning they say hi and in the evening they say bye. But times have become reversed. Here they say hi in the evening and bye in the morning.' On this Pawan Singh said - 'Boys? But these days girls too, they say I love you here, okay. Babu, I am coming back from praying at the temple. But that Babu's Babu, she didn't go to the temple, she went somewhere else. Now see if you look for faults, you'll find them here, you'll find them there (pointing towards actress) too. Therefore, to become a long-race horse, both need to stay good.' Third marriage discussion came up on birthday Pawan Singh has been married twice. His first marriage was to Neelam Singh, who passed away in 2015. After that, he married Jyoti Singh in 2018, whose divorce case is pending in court. His second wife accused the actor of domestic violence and forcing two abortions. She filed for divorce in 2021. However, for the past year, she has been asking the actor to accept her back. Pawan Singh's 40th birthday was on January 5th. He cut the cake in Lucknow. The next day a video surfaced. In which a girl was seen with Pawan Singh wearing sindoor and red bangles. The girl was standing very close to Pawan Singh. Pawan Singh was also eating cake from the girl's hand in a unique way. The girl seen with Pawan Singh is Bhojpuri film actress Mahima Singh, who hails from Banda district of Uttar Pradesh. She is working with Pawan Singh in a Bhojpuri movie, whose song 'Bani Laika' was also released on October 4. After the picture surfaced, there was speculation about whether Pawan Singh had married for the third time. However, family members denied this. Dainik Bhaskar reporter spoke to Pawan Singh's uncle Ashok Singh about the third marriage. He called this news baseless. However, he asked to wait until the decision in the ongoing divorce case with Jyoti Singh. Pawan Singh's affair with Akshara Singh Pawan Singh also had an affair with Akshara Singh. The actress had openly talked about this many times. She said that she used to take care of him like a wife. But the actor would beat her. When the actor had his second marriage, their relationship ended. She claimed that the actor had made her sign a contract. They had a contractual relationship. She also revealed that the actor's ex-girlfriend had committed suicide because of them. Additionally, she alleged that Pawan Singh had threatened to kill her and said she wouldn't get work in the industry.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav alleges Muslim votes being deleted:Claims govt plans to remove 1 crore voters in UP; says, 'pressure on DMs Commissioners'
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav on Tuesday alleged large-scale manipulation of voter lists in Uttar Pradesh, claiming that votes were being transferred and deleted using pen drives in constituencies where the BJP is unlikely to win. He said the alleged exercise began after the BJP’s setback in the Lok Sabha elections and is aimed at cutting the votes of the SP, Muslims and PDA communities. Addressing a press conference in Lucknow, Akhilesh said such actions raise serious questions over the credibility of the Election Commission. “Wherever the BJP is losing, votes are being sent through pen drives. After losing the Lok Sabha elections, preparations are being made to cut SP, Muslim and PDA votes,” he alleged. Akhilesh raises alarm over voter lists in UP The former chief minister claimed that there is a target to remove 1,99,710 voters from electoral rolls in Uttar Pradesh. “Pen drives have been prepared at the Assembly level. Pressure is being put on commissioners and district magistrates. The BJP knows it is going to lose Uttar Pradesh. People will defeat them this time, which is why such narratives are being pushed,” he said. Akhilesh further alleged large-scale manipulation of Form 7, which is used for deletion of names from electoral rolls. He claimed that names of voters from the Muslim community were being removed in large numbers. “BJP mandal presidents and booth-level BLOs are being given pen drives. Such reports are coming in continuously,” he said, adding that written complaints have been submitted to the Election Commission. Finalized overnight: Akhilesh on India-US trade deal The SP chief said his party has repeatedly demanded a robust verification mechanism for Form 7, citing evidence of irregularities. “Every Form 7 should have proper numbering. AI should be used to detect fraud. CCTV footage of those submitting forms must be retrieved. Cases related to conspiracy against the state and cheating should be registered against those involved,” he demanded. Commenting on the India-US trade deal, Akhilesh alleged that it was finalized overnight without transparency. “We do not know on what basis the deal was done or what agreements were made. Now foreign food will be on people’s plates,” he said. Key points from Akhilesh's press conference 1. Former MLA had advance information on which votes would be deleted Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav said the party received complaints alleging a conspiracy to deliberately remove Muslim voters’ names from electoral rolls. He claimed that when the SP investigated the matter, it found Form 7 applications filled in the names of people who do not even know how to sign, yet signatures were present on the forms. Akhilesh alleged that this was being done on a large scale in constituencies where the BJP had lost. He claimed that former MLA Yogesh Pratap had advance information about which votes would be deleted from which booths, specifically targeting PDA and Muslim voters. In Kannauj alone, he alleged that around 1,200 Muslim voters were selectively removed from the rolls. 2. Even BLOs’ own votes have been deleted The SP chief said the party would appeal to the Election Commission, stressing that voting is the most fundamental right in a democracy and must not be manipulated. He alleged that voter deletions were being carried out on a large scale in collusion with the BJP. Akhilesh claimed that some officials had stated that pressure was being exerted by the Chief Minister’s Office on IAS officers, including commissioners and district magistrates, to delete votes. He further alleged that Form 7 applications were being received in pre-printed form, many without signatures. He said Booth Level Officers (BLOs) were frustrated and disappointed, adding that in some cases, even the votes of BLOs themselves had been deleted. 3. Threats allegedly coming from the Chief Minister’s Office Akhilesh further alleged that threats were being issued from the Chief Minister’s Office and that district magistrates and commissioners had been given complete lists for voter deletion. Questioning the Election Commission, he asked whether officials were adhering to their constitutional oath. “It feels as though the country is being pushed towards something beyond One Nation, One Election,” he said. He also claimed that when complaints were raised about voter deletions, voters were being shown records of State Election Commission votes instead of Assembly or Lok Sabha voter lists. 4. Evidence of irregularities found in Chandauli, Sultanpur, Gonda and Lucknow Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav said evidence of serious irregularities had surfaced in Chandauli, Sultanpur, Gonda and Lucknow. He claimed that in Lucknow alone, applications were submitted to delete the names of more than 100 voters under the name of a single individual identified as Dashrath, using Form 7. “They cannot even commit wrongdoing intelligently,” he remarked. Akhilesh pointed out that under Rule 9.0.1, any person making a false statement to get a voter’s name deleted is liable for action. As per Election Commission of India rules, filing a false written declaration or applying on someone else’s behalf attracts prosecution under the Representation of the People Act, which carries a provision of up to one year’s imprisonment along with a fine. He alleged that despite clear violations, no action was being taken. “If this continues, the Election Commission might as well hoist the BJP’s flag on top of its office,” he said. 5. Not a single vote should be deleted or reduced Akhilesh appealed to PDA supporters to remain vigilant and collect evidence, urging them not to allow what he described as a conspiracy to succeed. “Not a single vote should be deleted, not a single vote should be reduced. We must unite and protect every vote,” he said. He warned that voter deletion could be used as a precedent to deny people government benefits in the future. “Tomorrow, the BJP government may stop facilities citing this as proof. Your name could be removed from welfare schemes,” he cautioned. Calling voter registration a symbol of citizenship, he said, “If you are a citizen, you are a voter.” He alleged that the BJP could enact any law, seize land or even confiscate gold. “Protect your vote to protect your future,” he urged. 6. Votes being transferred through pen drives where BJP is losing The SP chief alleged that in constituencies where the BJP is not winning, voter data is being transferred through pen drives. He claimed that people asked to sign documents were instead being made to give thumb impressions. According to him, in two assembly segments, thousands of votes were targeted for deletion using a single pen drive. He alleged that 1,200 votes were removed from Chhibramau alone. “Cutting 1,200 votes means reducing the lead by 1,200. In Assembly elections, victory margins are often within 5,000 votes. If the lead is reduced, the result changes,” he said. Drawing a parallel with West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee’s political struggle, Akhilesh said the Samajwadi Party was facing similar challenges and would respond step by step. “The BJP is scared of losing,” he added.
